title: Spending - Award Size
summary: Understand how project award amounts are distributed across the EPIC project portfolio.

steps.title: Award Size tab overview
steps.body: The Award Size tab is located within the Spending Insight on the Projects page. This tab helps users understand how project award amounts are distributed across the portfolio.

steps.title: Review key funding cards
steps.body: At the top, the key funding cards show the total number of projects, average award size, median award size, and largest award size. These cards give users a quick snapshot of overall award funding.

steps.title: Review distribution by award size
steps.body: The Distribution by Award Size section groups projects into different funding ranges. This helps users see how many projects fall into each award size category.

steps.title: Open projects by award size
steps.body: Once you find an award size range you want to review, click the project count to open the Projects List page filtered to projects within that award size range.
